title: A Flexible Method for Protecting Marketing Data: An Application to Point-of-Sale Data
authors: Matthew J. Schneider; Sharan Jagpal; Sachin Gupta; Shaobo Li; Yan Yu
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Bayesian data-protection method that generates synthetic store identities; the empirical application estimates brand price and promotion elasticities (continuous log price) with store FE to measure information loss.
design_notes: Code/empirical.R: lm(lSale ~ -1 + Store_ID + Brand:lPrice + Brand:promo) on STORE.csv (brand x store x week POS data); measure_func.R computes protection and information-loss metrics. No binary staggered treatment.
data_provenance_note: Store x week POS data used in the application; no transformation stated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); design taken from the OpenAlex abstract, README and code. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
